answer: Locks are entered in terrace, expire in willow, and pigment lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 21 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. An attacker running 25 aliases as a result needs 181 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 4585 identities would post 4090 proofs and burn roughly 69 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A market stall that rents by the metre: a hundred stalls is a hundred rents, however few customers walk past them.
